description: FFmpegKit / ffmpeg-kit, actively maintained. Drop-in replacement for com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-https (Arthenica's fork, retired April 2025) -- same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, just change the groupId. TLS/https:// URL support (gmp+gnutls). Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
